name: dialogue-memories
description: Turn conversations into stories of experience, creative work, lives, and imagined worlds. Four skills, starting with Memory.

interface.shortDescription: Share a memory. Become the heart of a story.
interface.longDescription: Start with Memory: talk about a trip or an everyday moment and grow it into a piece with you at its center. Memory is enough for everyday use. Explore Making for the story behind creative work, Legacy for a record of a life, or Fiction for stories grown from experience and ideas. Choose another skill when you want to explore a different form.
defaultPrompt: Turn something that happened yesterday into a short piece with me at its center.
I want to preserve a memory from a trip, but where should I start?
Write this memory in third person, like a documentary portrait.
